reader.selectionHint: Select source text to send it to the assistant
assistant.intro: Structural questions such as page count and headings are answered locally. Content questions retrieve paper evidence first, then DeepSeek answers only from that evidence with page citations.
assistant.newSessionPlaceholder: New session, e.g. Method deep dive
assistant.sessionHelp: Switching sessions changes only this paper's questions and notes; content from other papers is never mixed in.
assistant.readingGuideSubtitle: Generated from the real outline, not a fixed question list
assistant.guideQuestionMeta: Starts on page {page} · Select to fill the question
assistant.guideLoading: Preparing suggestions from the paper outline…
assistant.cachedTranslation: Reused local translation · API not called
assistant.noExtraUncertainty: No additional uncertainty was recorded for this answer.
assistant.loadingSelectionContext: Reading local context from this page…
assistant.selectionSendIntro: If no reusable translation exists, DeepSeek will receive page {page}, a {language} translation request, and {context}.
assistant.selectionWithContext: the exact selection plus same-page context (about {count} characters)
assistant.showSentContext: Show the context that will actually be sent
assistant.exactSelection: Exact selection (the only text to translate)
assistant.disambiguationContext: Same-page context used only for disambiguation
assistant.hybridSearchHelp: Combines exact terms and semantics; recommended
assistant.historyTitle: Confirm records before adding them to formal notes
assistant.historyIntro: Showing records from “{session}”. Check the citations, add your own understanding, and confirm a record before it can enter the paper card.
assistant.emptyHistoryBody: Your first cited answer will be saved here automatically.
assistant.sendScope: Structural questions stay local. For content questions, DeepSeek receives only your question and up to five local evidence passages, never the complete paper.
assistant.scopeAuto: Detect a section from the question
assistant.detectedSource: Local estimate: {language}. This does not change the translation target or PDF source.
assistant.overriddenSource: You set the source language to {language}. This does not change the translation target or PDF source.
assistant.questionPlaceholder: For example: Why can a Transformer process a sequence in parallel?
assistant.searchingAndAnswering: Retrieving evidence and generating an answer…

glossary.help: Terms are used for translation only when they occur in the selection or same-page context; they are not paper evidence.
glossary.useSelection: Use the current selection as the source term
glossary.errorSave: Failed to save the glossary term.
glossary.errorDelete: Failed to delete the glossary term.
history.noteRequired: Add your own understanding after checking the source text.
history.categoryRequired: Choose the paper-card section for this record.
history.notePlaceholder: Required: explain your understanding, questions, or counterexamples in your own words…
history.confirm: Review complete — add to paper card
outline.title: Select a heading to open its PDF page
outline.unavailableTitle: Could not identify a reliable outline
outline.unavailableBody: This PDF has no usable bookmarks or clearly numbered headings.
evidence.hybridHelp: Hybrid retrieval ranks keyword and semantic candidates separately, fuses their ranks, and reduces the weight of reference-list passages.
evidence.semanticHelp: Semantic retrieval finds passages by meaning; scores compare the relative order within this result set.
evidence.keywordHelp: Keyword retrieval counts matches for terms in the question.
status.scopeFallback: The requested section could not be identified reliably. Searched the full paper instead.
status.scopeSection: Search limited to {title}, PDF pages {start}–{end}. Section boundaries are page-based.
status.selectionParagraph: Context comes from the same-page paragraph; translation applies only to the exact selection.
status.selectionWindow: Paragraph boundaries are uncertain, so a short same-page context window is included; translation applies only to the exact selection.
status.selectionOnly: No reliable surrounding context was found; translation applies only to the exact selection.
status.guideUnavailable: Could not prepare reading suggestions from this paper's outline.
translation.title: Translate page {page}
translation.intro: The original PDF remains in the middle; this panel shows a translation of the current page and checks its local cache as you navigate.
translation.boundary: Only clicking the button sends this page's translatable text to DeepSeek, which may use API credits. Some uniquely located inline parameters, display equations, and ruled tables appear as original PDF clips. Verify other inline math, columns, and unrecognized tables against the PDF.
translation.target: Target language: {language}. Change it under paper language preferences in Ask.
translation.layoutRisk.multi_column_cand: Possible parallel text columns detected. The snippet list is not a verified reading order.
translation.layoutRisk.table_rulings_can: Table-like horizontal rules detected. Cell relationships have not been reconstructed.
translation.layoutRisk.small_glyph_fragm: Many small glyph fragments detected. Formula scripts or special characters may be damaged in text previews.
translation.layoutOrderUnverified: Trust the PDF image in the middle. This warning does not fix or retranslate the page.
translation.sourceRegionsLimit: Select a snippet to locate it in the PDF. These are text positions only: reading order and translation alignment are not verified. Trust the original image for math and special characters.
translation.sourceRegionsError: Could not load source locations. You can still inspect the original PDF.
translation.sourceRegionsEmpty: No text locations are available on this page.
translation.sourceRegionsRotated: Precise locations are not supported for rotated pages yet.
translation.sourceRegionsTruncated: This page has many regions; only the first 80 are shown.
translation.focusSourceRegion: Locate this source text in the PDF
translation.quality.review: Verify this page against the PDF
translation.quality.blocked: Translation is unavailable for this page
translation.quality.no_text: No selectable text was extracted; a scanned page needs OCR.
translation.quality.short_text: Very little text: this may be a cover, figure page, or incomplete extraction.
translation.quality.damaged_text: The text layer contains too many damaged characters to translate reliably.
translation.quality.long_text: This page is too long; select a shorter passage to read.
translation.quality.math_review: Math content detected. Some uniquely located inline parameters retain original PDF clips; other formulas and scripts may be lost during text extraction. Compare with the PDF.
translation.quality.column_order_review: A two-column layout is likely. No repeated interleaving was detected, but reading order is not verified; compare with the PDF.
translation.quality.column_order_mismatc: Extracted text repeatedly jumps between columns. Full-page translation is blocked; select one column or passage instead.
translation.quality.limit: This check catches only some obvious ordering failures; it cannot certify column order, inline math, or tables. Compare with the PDF in the middle.
translation.cached: Loaded from local cache · no API call
translation.mathNotice: These formula clips come directly from the original PDF, not the model. Trust their original glyphs and scripts; verify inline math without a clip in the middle PDF pane.
translation.tableNotice: A ruled table was detected. Its cells were not translated; the original PDF clip appears below. Verify rows, columns and formulas against the source.
translation.originalFormulaAria: Formula clipped from the original PDF
translation.originalTableAria: Table clipped from the original PDF; cells not translated
translation.tableScrollHint: Scroll sideways to inspect the original table.
translation.originalPreviewFailed: Source image preview unavailable. Check the original PDF in the middle pane.
translation.sourceCount: This page contains {count} extractable source characters. Original-PDF clip regions are not translated; the translation is not yet reviewed.
translation.noKey: DeepSeek API key is not configured. Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the project's .env file.
translation.errorLoad: Could not read the local translation for this page.
translation.errorGenerate: Page translation failed. Check DeepSeek configuration, the network, or the page text.
evidence.emptySection: No evidence matched within this section. Expand to the full paper or try another question.
evidence.emptyFull: Try another wording or switch between keyword and semantic retrieval.
evidence.noSearchBody: Return to “Ask” and enter a question to retrieve evidence from the current paper.
summary.title: Includes only understanding you confirmed
summary.intro: You have {count} confirmed records. At least two are required, and each needs a section selected under “Notes”.
summary.diff: Changes from the existing formal card
summary.exportVersion: Confirm changes and export a new version
summary.exportCard: Confirm content and export formal card
summary.versionSafety: The original card will not be modified; the new content is saved as a timestamped version.
summary.firstExportSafety: Future exports show a diff first and never overwrite this file.
summary.emptyBody: Confirm and categorize at least two reading records first.
info.aiScopeValue: Sends only the question and up to five retrieved evidence passages, never the complete PDF.
info.confirmedRecords: {count} records added to the paper card
